messages:
harper: FYI seeing a microburst of tiny writes on eu-west1 scratch nodes since 03:12 UTC, attach latency up ~3m for GPUs.
dasu: Got alert `scratch.iops.small_burst >= 1200` for 10m on zone eu-west1-c. A few hosts showing `blk_update_request` spikes.
rachel: Any SMART flags? or is this write amplification from tiny rename/atomic ops?
dasu: SMART looks nominal. dmesg shows lots of small write completions + overlay rename stalls on two hosts. Likely simultaneous model-cache writebacks + janitor sweep.
harper: Can we reduce janitor parallelism and stagger model-cache writes?
rachel: I'll throttle janitor on that affinity pool to 1 worker and flip model-cache prefetch to staggered wave (zones A->B->C). Rolling now.
dasu: Also tainting the worst nodes PreferNoSchedule for GPUs to let scheduler avoid them while we heal.
infra-bot: taint applied to euw-node-77, euw-node-79 at 03:25 UTC.
ops-bot: routing hint set: prefer us-west1 for new GPU allocs for 40m to reduce customer impact.
harper: After throttles and taints attach queue dropped ~70% in 8m. We'll keep monitoring for 30m before reverting.
rachel: Filing RFC for a small-write coalescer (50ms window) and hot-reserve policy to avoid cascading attach delays. Link to RFC will be posted.
harper: Thanks. I'll update #incidents and ping CS if attach regressions persist beyond the window. :thumbsup:
